[P.U. (A) 99 /2016] berhubung dengan permohonan bagi perakuan pendaftaran bagi

CIVIL AVIATION ACT 1969

CIVIL AVIATION (EXEMPTION) REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 3(2)(p) of the
Civil Aviation Act 1969 [Act 3], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1.  (1)   These regulations may be cited as the Civil Aviation ( Exemption)
Regulations 2017.

(2)  These Regulations come into operation on 20 October 2017.

Exemption
2. MAB Leasing Limited  is exempted from payment of the fees and charges under
paragraph 1 of the Schedule to the Civil Aviation (Fees and Charges) Regulations 2016
[P.U. (A) 99 /2016] in relation to application for certificate of registration for aircrafts
specified in the Schedule.
